Instant appeal is preferred against the judgment and order dated 11/13.08.2025, passed in Sessions Trial No. 87 of 2023, State of Uttarakhand Vs. Vijay Yadav @ Manish Yadav, by the court of Additional Sessions Judge, /F.T.S.C. Roorkee, District Haridwar.

sentences.text:
By it, the appellant has been convicted and sentenced under Section 376 (2)
(n), 354 C IPC and Section 67 of the Information Technology Act, 2000.
He seeks bail in this appeal.

2. Heard.
3.
This is an admitted appeal.

4. List for hearing on 20.03.2026.
Heard on Bail Application No. 01 of 2025 5 According to the prosecution case, the appellant and the victim both came into contact.
They started talking to each other and under a compulsion, the appellant established physical relations with the victim and continued doing so.
He started calling the victim for physical relations and extended threat in case, she would not come he would make her obscene photographs and videos viral.
Subsequently, the intimate photographs and videos of the victim and the applicant were made viral.

sentences.text: 6. Learned counsel for the appellant would submit that the appellant did not make the videos viral.
It is a case of establishing physical relations under the pretext of marriage.
The appellant was not on bail during trial.
He submits that, in fact, the statement of PW5 confirms that the appellant did not make the videos viral.
7. Learned counsel for the informant submits that it is not that only videos were made viral, but they were sent by the appellant to the brother and sister of the victim.
8. Learned State counsel submits that prosecution has proved the case beyond reasonable doubt.
9. The kind of allegations that are levelled against the appellant are quite serious.
The victim has stated about it.
The victim has stated about the prosecution case.
She has stated that she was forcibly raped by the appellant.
She was blackmailed and her intimate photographs were made viral.
10. Having considered, this Court is of the view that there is no reason to enlarge the appellant on bail.
The bail application deserves to be rejected.
11. The bail application is rejected.
(Ravindra Maithani, J.) 04.12.2025
